description: Find road freight carriers in Europe that run a route and offer the equipment, services or certificates a load needs. Write the query plainly: the places of loading and delivery (town, postcode or country), then what is needed, e.g. "reefer from Venlo to Rome", "ADR tank Rotterdam to Poland", "groupage Germany to Italy, tail lift". "based in Italy" keeps carriers based there. Returns the carriers that fit, best first, with what the search understood: if that is not what the user meant, phrase the query again. Then call get_carrier for contact details.

language.description: Language of the labels and of the links to the site: the user's language, when Fitralo has it.

query.description: The route and needs in plain words, in English or the language given.

specialists_only.description: Only carriers for whom this route (or area) is their own line, not one among many.
